title: Danang International Marathon 2027 Review: Vietnam's Coastal Classic Returns
seo_title: Danang International Marathon 2027 Review | Course & Date Guide
meta_description: An early look at the Danang International Marathon 2027: March 21 in Da Nang, Vietnam. Three distances from 10K to full marathon, registration opens July 2026. Coastal Vietnam's flagship road race.
dek: Set for 21 March 2027 in Da Nang — Vietnam's coastal running capital — this marathon offers three distances (42K, 21K, 10K) with registration opening on 8 July 2026. Here's what the early signals say about one of Vietnam's most established road races.
verdict: The Danang International Marathon has established itself as one of Vietnam's anchor road races — a coastal marathon in a city that has invested heavily in its running infrastructure, with a March date that lands in central Vietnam's dry season. Three distances give it broad appeal, and the 8 July 2026 registration opening date means the organiser has its operational timeline in order well ahead of race day. The course is flat and fast by Vietnamese standards, hugging the Han River and the Da Nang coastline. Suits runners who want a well-organised Vietnamese marathon with a beach holiday built in; PB chasers will find the coastal profile accommodating.

sections.heading: The Course: Han River, Coastal Roads, Da Nang's Bridges
paragraphs: The Danang International Marathon route is built around the city's defining features: the Han River, the coastline, and Da Nang's collection of illuminated bridges — the Dragon Bridge, the Han River Bridge, and the Tran Thi Ly Bridge among them. [1] The course is predominantly flat, with bridge crossings providing the only meaningful elevation changes, making it one of Vietnam's more PB-friendly marathon profiles.

Past editions have started in the pre-dawn hours, with the full marathon field crossing the Han River bridges as the city lights reflect off the water — a visual that returning runners consistently cite as a highlight. The 2027 edition is expected to follow a similar template, though the exact route map has not yet been published.

sections.heading: The Date: March in Central Vietnam's Dry Season
paragraphs: 21 March sits squarely in central Vietnam's dry season, which runs from February through August. [1] Compared with the wet, typhoon-prone months of September through December, March offers some of the most reliable running conditions in the country — morning temperatures in the low-to-mid 20s Celsius, manageable humidity, and low rain probability.

That seasonal advantage is one reason the Danang International Marathon has grown steadily: runners can plan around March knowing the weather is unlikely to derail race day. An early-morning flag-off is standard, and the flat coastal profile means the climate, not the terrain, is the main variable to manage.

sections.heading: Registration: Opens 8 July 2026
paragraphs: The organiser has confirmed that registration for the 2027 edition opens on 8 July 2026. [1] That's a useful piece of advance intelligence — it gives prospective runners a concrete date to set a calendar reminder, rather than the vague 'check back later' that characterises most 2027 races at this stage.

Three distances are offered: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21km), and 10km. [1] The absence of a 5km fun run keeps the event focused on distance running rather than community participation, which may suit serious runners who prefer a streamlined race-day experience.

sections.heading: Da Nang as a Race Destination
paragraphs: Da Nang has positioned itself as Vietnam's running city. The Danang International Marathon is the anchor event, but the city also hosts the VnExpress Marathon Da Nang and numerous smaller races throughout the year. That concentration of events means the city's infrastructure — hotels, transport, post-race dining — is calibrated for runners.

Beyond race day, Da Nang offers a genuine holiday: My Khe Beach runs for kilometres along the coast, the Marble Mountains and Son Tra Peninsula provide pre-race sightseeing, and Hoi An is a 30-minute drive south for post-race recovery. For runners travelling with non-running partners or family, it's one of the easier sells on the Vietnamese calendar.

sections.heading: Should You Register?
paragraphs: Set a calendar reminder for 8 July 2026 — that's when registration opens, and the Danang International Marathon has historically drawn a strong field.
